enemies.name: Slime marin
enemies.description: Small teal tide slime with embedded cream shells and expressive angry eyes. No crown.

enemies.name: Slime couronné de corail
enemies.description: Large asymmetrical teal tide slime with embedded shells and a broken red coral crown. Black diamond control seal on forehead.

enemies.name: Crabe des sables
enemies.description: Small orange sand crab with grey rounded pebbles for a carapace, orange eyes, unequal claws.

enemies.name: Ermite au tonneau
enemies.description: Large orange red hermit crab whose shell is a weathered wooden barrel lashed with rope, scrap planks and seaweed. Large expressive orange eyes.

enemies.name: Goéland corrompu
enemies.description: Small pale grey coastal gull with hooked yellow beak, spiky dark grey crown feathers, angry eyes and dark webbed feet.

enemies.name: Goéland harponné
enemies.description: Large dark grey menacing gull with white chest, hooked red orange beak, spiky crown feathers, a harpoon embedded diagonally in its back and a frayed fishing net cape. Subtle violet control marks.

enemies.name: Slime de saumure
enemies.description: Small golden amber coastal brine slime with fish bones visible inside, little white salt flecks, fierce round eyes. No crown.

enemies.name: Slime des marais salants
enemies.description: Large golden amber brine slime wearing jagged white translucent salt crystal armour on its top and shoulders, monstrous expressive mouth, black diamond control seal on side. Keep salt white not purple.

enemies.name: Gobelin récupérateur
enemies.description: Tiny wiry ochre green goblin scavenger, oversized ragged brown fisher hat, rope belt, patched brown tunic, barefoot, sly sharp face. Carries a rope-bound scrap spear correctly in front hand.

enemies.name: Maître des casiers
enemies.description: Hunched larger ochre green goblin trapper with big sinister grin, oversized ragged fisher hat, red sash, torn brown tunic, crab pot basket and scavenged net bundle on back. Front hand holds a hooked rope grappling hook, back hand small club.

enemies.name: Scarabée des marées
enemies.description: Small broad deep cobalt blue tidal beetle, angular blue armour plates with golden edging, small black diamond mark, six walking legs, strong short mandibles. NOT a crab.

enemies.name: Homard aux pinces entravées
enemies.description: Huge scarlet red lobster with unequal enormous claws, segmented spiny shell and tail, long antennae, dark iron magic shackles marked with tiny violet runes on claw wrists. Distinct from round crabs.

enemies.name: Squelette pêcheur
enemies.description: Thin ivory skeleton fisherman with dark torn sailor bandanna, scraps of brown clothes, dangling green seaweed, expressive skull. Front hand grips a broken wooden oar as weapon, back hand empty.

enemies.name: Gardien noyé à l’ancre
enemies.description: Bulky drowned anchor keeper wearing a weathered round bronze antique diving helmet with grille window, long seaweed beard hanging from helmet, battered dark grey heavy coat and cracked shoulder armour. Front hand firmly grips heavy anchor on short chain, back hand a blunt iron hook. No exposed human face.

enemies.name: Crabe des épaves
enemies.description: Small rust red crab with scrap plank shell, a few iron nails and barnacles, uneven pincers, expressive eyes. No mast or entire ship.

enemies.name: Brise-Coque
enemies.description: Massive red ochre crab with oversized asymmetrical claws and whole weathered fishing boat wreck mounted on its carapace: broken mast, black torn sail, ropes, planks, barnacles. Black diamond magical control seal on bow. Region boss. Keep imposing low broad silhouette.
